name: May I Come in Madam?
description: Sajan Agarwal is mentally tortured by his mother-in-law and Bhupesh. He falls in love with his new boss, Sanjana.

videos.title: Sajan, Na Ghar Ke Na Ghat Ke
videos.overview: Sajan Agarwal, works as a manager for an advertising company and is fascinated by his glamorous boss, Sanjana. Sajan's wife, Kashmira is suspicious of his friendship with Sanjana. Will Sajan be able to balance between the wife and the boss?

videos.title: Sajan Pe Laga Lipstick Ka Nishan
videos.overview: Sajan and Sanjana have a moment in the lift. Later, Sanjana calls Sajan into her cabin for a discussion on a new lipstick brand. She leaves a lipstick mark on his shirt, which could land Sajan in a lot of trouble at home.

videos.title: Sajan Ki Shirt Ban Gayi Musibat
videos.overview: Sajan gives a sizzling presentation of 'Mandakini' lipstick, wearing a wet shirt. The shirt, later lands him in a lot of problems. It also invites the wrath of his 'nocturnal' Dadi!

videos.title: Sanjana-sajan Lock Lips
videos.overview: Sajan is worried because his boss, Sanjana wants him to get the lipstick-stained shirt to office and he can't find it. He pretends to have a 'gas' problem. Sanjana decides to give him a mouth to mouth treatment. Will Sajan recover now?

videos.title: Sanjana's Saadi Pad Gayi Bhaari
videos.overview: Kashmira's mother tries to make her realise that Sajan is not loyal to her and doesn't remember important dates. Sanjana asks Sajan to get her sari from the laundry. The sari create a lot of confusion. In short, Sanjana ki saadi pad gayi Sajan pe bhaari!

videos.title: Sanju's 'goonda'wala Fantasy
videos.overview: Sanjana calls up Sajan to tell him that she is going to visit his house to pick her sari. Sajan is in a soup because Kashmira has worn the sari! Sajan tries various tricks including behaving like a 'filmi' goonda to make Kashmira take it off but with hilarious consequences!

videos.title: Madam De Gayi Gift
videos.overview: Sajan asks his friend Khiloni to bail him out. Sanjana, however, slaps Khiloni hard! Later, she reaches Sanju's house and decides to gift the sari to Kashmira. Sajan heaves a sigh of relief but Madam has a change of mind!

videos.title: Sajan's 'wet' Dream
videos.overview: Sajan's happiness turns fourfold when a drenched Sanjana comes knocking at his door! One look at her wet hair and his imagination starts running wild. While Kashmira is on her way back home, Sajan and Sanjana are disturbed by a knock at the door.

videos.title: Sajan Ki Baj Gayi Band
videos.overview: Sanjana plays with her words to seduce Sajan which sends his imagination racing. As the rain comes to a stop, Sanjana decides to leave. Just then, Sajan's mother-in-law comes knocking at the door and sees Sanjana!  Will she tell her daughter about Sanjana? Kya Sajan Ka Bajega Band?

videos.title: Sajan's Pants Are Off
videos.overview: Sajan brings a snake to the office with the intention of impressing Sanjana by saving her. Bhupesh spills hot tea on him and Sajan rushes to clean it. When he puts his pants out to dry, someone takes them away!

videos.title: Sajan, Caught With Pants Down?
videos.overview: Sajan tries his best to keep himself from being seen in his underwear. Just then Sanjana calls Sajan for an urgent meeting. During Sajan's presentation, the snake crawls up his leg. Later, Kashmira arrives at Sajan's office.

videos.title: Holi Ke Rang, Sanjana Ke Sang
videos.overview: Sanjana is surprised to see Sajan without his pants. Sajan tells Kashmira that he does not like celebrating Holi. Later, Sanjana tells him that she loves playing Holi. Chedilal applies colour on Sajan and he fantasises about playing Holi with Sanjana.

videos.title: Bhaang, Ladoo Aur Sanjana!
videos.overview: Sanjana asks Sajan to get bhaang for her. Sajan tells his friend that Kashmira doesn't want him to play Holi. Sanjana calls Sajan and urges him to play Holi with her. Sajan reaches office with bhaang ladoos and a water gun.

videos.title: Sajan Ko Yaad Rahegi Yeh Holi
videos.overview: Sajan eats a bhaang laddoo at Sanjana's insistence. She, too, eats a few laddoos. Watch if a high-on-bhaang Sanjana fulfills Sajan's 'Holi' fantasies.

videos.title: Sanjana Decides To Visit Sajan
videos.overview: Sanjana asks Sajan to have dinner with her to discuss a project. Sajan recalls his promise to Kashmira about taking her mother for dinner and lies to Sanjana that his mother-in-law is sick. Sanjana decides to visit Sajan's home to see his ailing mother-in-law. Will Sajan be caught this time?

videos.title: Sajan Ki Saas Ne Li Uski Saans
videos.overview: Sajan's friend pretends to be his mother-in-law in front of Sanjana and her father but his family returns home earlier than expected. Later, Sanjana arranges a prayer meeting for Sajan's ailing mother-in-law!

videos.title: Sajan-sanjana Chale Date Pe!
videos.overview: Sanjana sends a doctor to Sajan's house to cure his mother-in-law! On Sanjana's order, Sajan dresses up smartly for office. Sanjana tells Sajan that she wants to go on a date with him.

videos.title: Phas Gaya Re Sajan!
videos.overview: Sanjana asks Sajan to pretend to be her boyfriend to get rid of her ex-boyfriend, Chandan. Bhupesh finds Sanjana in Sajan's arms. Chandan threatens Sajan on finding out that he is married! Later, at home, Sajan has a tough time explaning to Kashmira.

videos.title: Sajan Wants To Be Sanjana's Love
videos.overview: Sajan tells Sanjana that Chandan is at his house. He calls Sajan and threatens to reveal his secret. Sajan appears with his face covered before Chandan. Kashmira is furious when Sajan blurts out that he wants to be Sanjana's love forever.

videos.title: Hot Model Aur Phas Gaya Sajan
videos.overview: Sanjana asks Sajan to shoot a romantic ad with a hot model. The same pictures are soon shared on the social network. Later, Kashmira asks Sajan for the password to his social network account. Sajan shares his worry with Sanjana and his mother-in-law overhears the same!

videos.title: Sanjana Ne Padha Sajan Ka Haath
videos.overview: Sajan stops Kashmira from checking his social network account. Sanjana informs Sajan that the client will be using his photograph for their commercial. Meanwhile, Sajan imagines lifting Sanjana to help her fetch a book. Later, Sanjana reads Sajan's palm.

videos.title: Ab Toh Sajan Doob Gaya
videos.overview: Sanjana asks Sajan about his acts of bravery. Sajan lies about swimming across many rivers in a single breath. Sanjana wants Sajan to teach her swimming. Later, Sajan asks Khiloni to help him learn swimming. Khiloni lies to Kashmira that Sajan drowned while rescuing a woman!

videos.title: Madam Ne Pehna Swimsuit?
videos.overview: Sanjana tells Sajan about her dream of swimming in the sea. Sajan's imagination starts running wild again! He also imagines seeing Sanjana in a swimming costume. Will Sajan's dreams bear any fruit?

videos.title: Sajan Ki Haath Safaai!
videos.overview: Sanjana asks Sajan to take the measurements of a model. The model turns out to be a mannequin. While taking the measurements, Sajan accidentally breaks her hand! Ab kya karega Sajan?

videos.title: Sajan Is Attacked!
videos.overview: Sanjana recalls her friend's story about a killer when she sees a hand poking out of a sack under Sajan's desk. Meanwhile, the same killer enters Sajan's cabin. Mistakenly, Sanjana hands over a knife to the actual killer who then attacks Sajan.

videos.title: Sajan's Topless Portrait!
videos.overview: Sajan receives a text message from Sanjana saying that she wishes to paint a topless portrait of him. He workouts for a perfectly toned body. Later, Sanjana realises that she had by mistake sent the message to Sajan when he removes his shirt and poses for a portrait in front of her.

videos.title: Sajan Strips For Madam
videos.overview: Sanjana asks Sajan to completely strip down for the portrait. Meanwhile, even as a naked Sajan waits for Sanjana, Kashmira catches him in the same state! Later, a Bengali baba predicts that Sajan might leave Kashmira for another woman.

videos.title: Madam Ke Baalon Mein Uljha Sajan
videos.overview: A baba advises Sajan to attach a few strands of Sanjana's hair to a magical doll to have complete control over Sanjana. Sajan tries his best to complete his task, while Bhupesh tries to make Sajan drink the enchanted water.

videos.title: Will Sajan Get Lucky?
videos.overview: Bhupesh squeezes the 'mystical' lemon on Sajan's head. Sajan manages to cut off a few strands of Sanjana's hair when she requests him for a head massage. The moment Sajan attaches the hair to the enchanted doll, Sanjana asks him to stay and continue to work in the same office.

videos.title: Sajan Ke Paas Bandook!
videos.overview: Sajan dreams of hypnotising Sanjana with a doll. Later, he gets to know about the fake black magician. Chedilal tells Sajan and Bhupesh that Sanjana used to like a goon, Mannu. Sajan starts keeping a pistol in order to impress Sanjana.

videos.title: Sajan Joins Madam's Gang
videos.overview: Khiloni pretends to be a goon before Sanjana, to help Sajan prove his machoism. Sanjana tells Sajan that she is the leader of Kali Bijli gang and asks him to join her. Later, Sajan narrowly escapes the police.

videos.title: Sajan Gets Cold Feet
videos.overview: Sanjana asks Sajan to deliver a package for the last time. Chedilal also pretends to be involved in smuggling. Sajan encounters the police while he is on a mission and later panics seeing them in the office. Out of fear, Sajan confesses to Sanjana that he was lying about being a goon.

videos.title: Sajan Ki Shirt Safed Kaise?
videos.overview: Sajan and Sanjana go to a disco. A tarot card reader tells Sanjana that the man of her dreams will meet her in white shirt and blue trousers. Kashmira confronts Sajan for coming home late. Guess, who turns up wearing a white shirt?

videos.title: Saala Pad Gaya Sajan Pe Bhaari
videos.overview: Sajan is irritated to learn that Sanjana is interested in Bhupesh. Later, Sanjana confronts Sajan for being rude to Bhupesh. Bhupesh gets promoted to Sajan's position. Back home, a possessed Kashmira punishes Sajan for speaking ill about Bhupesh!

videos.title: Sajan Ki Nayi Chaal
videos.overview: While Sanjana and Bhupesh romance, a frustated Sajan disguises as a pregnant woman and claims that it is Bhupesh's child. Will Madam catch Sajan's bluff or is Bhupesh in trouble?

videos.title: Sajan Wants Madam Ki Sympathy
videos.overview: Sanjana tells Sajan that she can't help comforting people who are sad or upset. The next day, Sajan narrates his dukhbhari kahani to Sanjana, claiming that Kashmira doesn't treat him well. Later, at home, Sajan faces Dadi!

videos.title: Madam Ne Ki Sajan Ki Taarif
videos.overview: Sajan sneaks out at night to have pizza with Sanjana. The following day, Sanjana puts a board outside her cabin reading, 'Dogs and Sajan not allowed'. Later, in the evening, she pays Kashmira a visit! Why?

videos.title: Sanjana's Secret Tattoo
videos.overview: Sajan is shocked to see Kashmira in Sanjana's cabin. Sanjana gifts Kashmira and Sajan a holiday package to Goa. The following day, Sanjana tells Sajan that she has got a tattoo done. Meanwhile at home, Kashmira insists that Sajan gets her name tattooed.

videos.title: Kya Sajan Pakda Jaayega?
videos.overview: Sanjana ignores Sajan in the lift. He comes to know about Sanjana's displeasure with tattoos. He goes to a hospital to get it removed, but bumps into his sister-in-law and Kashmira!

videos.title: Sajan Ke 'model' Sapne
videos.overview: Kashmira comes to know that Sajan got the tattoo removed. Sanjana later asks Sajan to model for an ad campaign. But Sajan's happiness is short-lived!

videos.title: Sanjana's Night Out With Sajan
videos.overview: Sanjana invites Sajan for dinner as her father Chhedilal is going out of town. When Sanjana's Russian friend does not turn up at the last moment, she decides to spend the night at Sajan's place!

videos.title: Sapne Sajan Ke!
videos.overview: Sajan falls off the bed dreaming about Sanjana. He sneaks into Kashmira's room. Later, Sajan lies to Sanjana that Kashmira doesn't like her. He returns home drunk!

videos.title: Ab Biwi, Madam Saath Mein!
videos.overview: Sanjana is frightened after meeting Dadi. Kashmira fights with Sajan for not taking her to the movie. Sajan is shocked to learn that Sanjana has hired Kashmira!

videos.title: Kashmira Ne Li Sajan Ki Class
videos.overview: Sanjana and Kashmira enter the office together. Sajan feels left out. Kashmira is Sajan's new boss and wants him to complete his work on time. Sajan requests Sanjana to fire Kashmira.

videos.title: Sajan, Sanjana Saath Saath!
videos.overview: Kashmira catches Sajan inside Sanjana's tent. Sajan wants to quit his job, but Sanjana wants Kashmira to leave. Sanjana plans to send Kashmira to Singapore, but she declines the offer and later quits her job.

videos.title: Sajan, Sanjana Ka Dostana
videos.overview: Sanjana confides in Chedilal about being friendless. Sajan hides his identity and becomes a friend to Sanjana. Later, Sajan finds himself in trouble when Chedilal and Kashmira, thinking him to be Sanjana’s anonymous friend call and talk about him.

videos.title: Sajan Ka Naya Affair?
videos.overview: Sanjana calls and disturbs Sajan while he romances with Kashmira. She complains to him about her anonymous friend not answering her call. Sajan pulls a prank on Bhupesh. Sanjana tells Kashmira that Sajan is having an affair. Is Sajan in trouble again?

videos.title: Khiloni Ki Anokhi Salah
videos.overview: Sanjana gets irritated listening to Sajan's shayari. Khiloni advises Sajan to keep away from Sanjana in order to attract her towards him. Sajan applies the same theory at home and romances with Kashmira to get rid of her, while at office he avoids Sanjana to get her attention.

videos.title: Sajan Gets Romantic
videos.overview: Sajan continues to ignore Sanjana. He gifts a bottle of expensive scotch to Khiloni! Kashmira gets irritated when Sajan wakes her up in the night and tries to act romantic. Will Khiloni's plan work for Sajan?

videos.title: Swiss Alps Are Calling Sajan
videos.overview: Sanjana asks Sajan if he would like to go to the mountains for some office work. Sajan tells her that he has phobia for mountains. What will Sajan do when the trip is actually a visit to Switzerland with Madam?

videos.title: Sajan Ki Nayi Mushkil
videos.overview: Sanjana insists that Sajan should get his NOC form signed by Kashmira. Acting on Khiloni's advice, he tries to provoke his family. Later, he resorts to emotional drama to convince Kashmira.

videos.title: Sajan Ke Saath Hua Dhokha
videos.overview: Sajan faints on learning that he is going to Nainital and not Switzerland. Later, he learns about Sanjana's adventurous camping trip. He takes Khiloni's advice to go camping with her.

videos.title: Sajan Bana Sajni
videos.overview: Sajan behaves like a woman and plans for a kitty party in front of Sanjana. Later, Sajan introduces his friends, Mrs Takkar and Kanchu to Sanjana. At home, Kashimira is shocked to see Sajan in her nightgown.

videos.title: Sajan Ko Mila Invitation
videos.overview: Sajan continues to behave like a woman. Sanjana panics when Sajan enters the ladies toilet. Kashmira tells Sanjana about Sajan's weird behaviour. Later, Sanjana invites Sajan to join her for the camp.

videos.title: Sanjana, Sajan Are Friends?
videos.overview: Sanjana compliments Sajan for having found a true friend in him. Sajan confesses to Sanjana that he behaved like a woman to make her feel less lonely. Later, Khiloni advises Sajan to save his job by proving his masculinity.

videos.title: Madam Ne Maangi Sajan Ki Kidney
videos.overview: Bhupesh collects the wrong diagnostic report of Haseena from the hospital. The family members misunderstand thinking Haseena's kidneys have failed! To test Sajan's loyalty towards the company, Sanjana asks Sajan to donate one of his kidneys to Chedilal!

videos.title: Bura Phasa Sajan
videos.overview: Sajan is in a dilemma whether to donate his kidney or not after Kashmira asks him to donate his kidney to her mother. Meanwhile, Chedilal and Sanjana continue with their prank. Will Sajan donate his kidney to anyone?

videos.title: Sajan Ki Anokhi Demand
videos.overview: Bhupesh tells the family members that he collected the wrong medical report. Sajan demands Chedilal to give him a share in the company in exchange of his kidney. Later, Kashmira learns about Sajan's decision to give his kidney to Chedilal.

videos.title: Madam Ko Khaana Hai Achaar
videos.overview: Sanjana asks Sajan to get her the pickle he brought in his lunchbox. Sajan flatters Kashmira to get the pickle jar from her. Later, he manages to steal the jar and gives it to Sanjana!

videos.title: Sajan Ki Khiloni Chachi
videos.overview: Sajan retrieves the pickle jar from Sanjana. She expresses her desire to learn the pickle recipe from Sajan's aunt. Khiloni disguises as his aunt. Meanwhile, Kashmira invites Sajan's aunt for dinner.

videos.title: Ab Kya Karega, Sajan?
videos.overview: Sajan promises to take Kashmira out for dinner. Sanjana calls for a meeting and asks her employees to work overtime. What will now happen to Sajan and Kashmira's dinner date?

videos.title: Dadi Ne Diya Sajan Ko Order
videos.overview: Sanjana-Sajan go to a restaurant for a client meeting. Kashmira is angry to see them together. Dadi orders Sajan to take Kashmira out for dinner. Sajan pretends to be sick so that he can leave the office.

videos.title: Sajan Sirf Sach Bolega
videos.overview: A client introduces Sanjana to a pill that makes people speak the truth. She decides to test the pill on Sajan. Later, Sajan humiliates Kashmira when she asks him about her sari. The next day, he confides his deed to Sanjana.

videos.title: Kashmira Kholegi Sajan's Raaz
videos.overview: The effect of the truth pill continues. Sajan fails to stop himself from insulting Chedilal. Sanjana stops Chedilal from firing Sajan. Kashmira decides to make the most of 'Sajan's truth telling' exercise. Will Sajan land in some big trouble?

videos.title: Sajan Bana Kaam Wali Bai!
videos.overview: Sajan is made to sit on the hot seat and is bombarded with questions. Later, Sanjana tells Sajan that her maid has left the job. Sajan reaches her house disguised as a maid.

videos.title: Meet Shanta Lopez!
videos.overview: A woman called Shanta Lopez visits Sanjana's house. Later, Sanjana questions Sajan for coming late to office. Kashmira suspects Sajan's actions and asks Bhupesh to spy on him. Later, Chedilal tries to flirt with Shanta.

videos.title: Kab Tak Bachega Sajan?
videos.overview: Sanjana confronts Sajan for being late to work. She asks Shanta to make dinner at Kashmira's house. Later, Kashmira and Bhupesh find women's clothes in Sajan's bag!

videos.title: Chedilal Ki Shaadi Shanta Se?
videos.overview: Sanjana asks Shanta to marry Chedilal. Sajan tries hard to explain Kashmira about the women's clothes in his bag. Khiloni visits Sanjana's house as Shanta's husband!

videos.title: Sajan's Madam Gayi Out Of Hand
videos.overview: How will Sajan tackle a hypnotised Sanjana as she gets too hot to handle? Sajan is in deep trouble when Khiloni tells him about the stolen book!

videos.title: Sajan Hypnotises Kashmira
videos.overview: Sajan retrieves the book from the gorilla and hypnotises Kashmira. Meanwhile, what is Sanjana doing in Sajan's house?

videos.title: Kya Bhupesh Ki Lottery Lagegi?
videos.overview: Will Sajan succeed in his attempt to hypnotise his family and erase the memory of Sanjana's visit? Later, Bhupesh buys a lottery ticket with Sajan's money!

videos.title: Sajan Bana Crorepati
videos.overview: Sajan claims the lottery money. He tells Chedilal to make him his business partner and gifts a bike to Bhupesh. Later, he tries to brag about his changed status before Sanjana.

videos.title: Sajan Ko Mila Thenga
videos.overview: Chedilal and Sanjana want Sajan to prove that he is a crorepati. Later, a shock awaits Sajan when he calls the lottery office. How will Sajan deal with it?

videos.title: Meet Janu, Madam's Cousin!
videos.overview: Sanjana deliberately puts Sajan into trouble when Kashmira calls him. Kashmira misunderstands Sajan to be with another woman. Meanwhile, Madam's cousin, Janu arrives on the scene!

videos.title: Kashmira Ka Ban Gaya Janu
videos.overview: Sajan gets angry on seeing Janu romance Kashmira. However, he is unaware about a bigger plan!

videos.title: Janu Ne Li Sajan Ki Jaan
videos.overview: Janu continues to romance with Kashmira. At the office, Sanjana tells Sajan about Janu's past affairs with married women. Is there cause for concern for Sajan?

videos.title: Madam Bheegi Baarish Mein
videos.overview: Sanjana expresses her desire to get drenched in the rain. Despite being sick, Sajan goes to the office the next day to watch her enjoy the rain. Will everything happen as Sajan wished?

videos.title: Madam Ki Fantasy
videos.overview: Bhupesh finds Sajan jumping up and down in the rain and asking Sanjana to join him. Later, Sanjana tells Sajan about her fantasy to see a man, drenched!

videos.title: Sajan Baal Baal Bacha?
videos.overview: Chedi invites Kashmira's mother for tea. Sajan starts using a hair tonic. But will it benefit him?

videos.title: Sajan Ka Ujda Chaman!
videos.overview: Sajan covers his head with a bandana and goes to office. Sanjana is disgusted to see his bald head and asks him to stay away from her. Sajan's problems double up when Kashmira too asks him to not come home!

videos.title: Sajan Ko Mili Jadui Dawai
videos.overview: Sajan is depressed as everyone ignores him because of his baldness. Meanwhile, Khiloni provides him with a quick solution to get his hair back.

videos.title: Sajan Ka Paanv Kabar Mein
videos.overview: Sanjana asks Sajan to spend a night with her at the cemetery. Fear grips Sajan at the graveyard when someone in a mask scares him!

videos.title: Bhaago Sajan, Bhoot Aaya?
videos.overview: Someone slaps Sajan inside the lift when the lights go off. Later, some uncanny incidents leave him unnerved. Someone calls out his name when he is alone at home! Who is it?

videos.title: Sajan Ke Peeche Bhoot?
videos.overview: Sajan tells Sanjana about his encounter with a ghost. The next day, they visit a graveyard where an old man tells them that they resemble people from the past!

videos.title: Madam High 'spirit' Mein!
videos.overview: Sanjana wants to meet Johny's ghost. At night, she disguises herself as Julie and tries to flirt with Sajan to summon Johny's spirit.

videos.title: Sajan Ko Mila Johny Se Chutkara
videos.overview: Sanjana orders Sajan to summon Dadi's ghost or else! Sajan tries to insult Kashmira to summon Dadi. Later, Dadi's ghost saves Sanjana and Sajan from Johny's ghost!

videos.title: Sajan Ka Naya Dhong
videos.overview: Khiloni reminds Sajan about his marriage anniversary after he plans to go out with Sanjana for dinner. Later, he pretends to have lost his memory in order to avoid Kashmira's anger. Will Sajan succeed in his act?

videos.title: Sajan Bana Chaprasi!
videos.overview: Sajan ends up squatting flies and preparing tea for Sanjana after Chedilal makes him a peon! His situation gets worse at home. Find out why.

videos.title: Kya Pakda Jayega Sajan?
videos.overview: Sanjana flirts with Sajan to summon Dadi, hoping that he will recall everything. Later, she calls him to her house and asks him to give a back massage to Chedilal. Is Sajan falling into Sanjana's trap?

videos.title: Sajan Bana Madam Ka Chamcha
videos.overview: The loss of another major client leads Sanjana to put ridiculous suggestions into effect. Soon, she turns Sajan into her personal office pet!

videos.title: It's A Dog's Life For Sajan!
videos.overview: Bhupesh finds Sanjana tying a dog's collar on Sajan's neck. Later, Sanjana asks Kashmira to treat Sajan like a dog. What happens next that makes Sajan an 'aggressive dog!'

videos.title: Madam Ke Liye Kuch Bhi Karega
videos.overview: Sajan brags that he can spend money to get Sanjana out of any problem. She lies to him that someone is threatening to release her obscene pictures if she doesn't pay him. What will Sajan do?

videos.title: Sajan Ne Ki Chori
videos.overview: Sanjana tells Sajan that the kidnapper is blackmailing her for more money. Sajan steals money from Kashmira's purse and later, disguises himself as a robber!

videos.title: Sajan Ne Ki Maang Puri
videos.overview: Sanjana manipulates Sajan into getting more money for her, getting him into trouble with Kashmira. Later, Sajan is depressed when he sees Sanjana!

videos.title: Sajan Ban Gaya Love Guru
videos.overview: Sajan is beaten up by Manu for insulting him in front of Sanjana. However, Sanjana reveals to him that she was pretending to be Manu's wife all this time. Later, Sajan poses as Love Guru, Aashiq Awara.

videos.title: Madam Ne Dil Ki Raaz Kholi!
videos.overview: Sajan puts a fake snake under Sanjana's desk and tries to act heroic by saving her. Later, Sanjana calls Love Guru Aashiq Awara and bares her heart to him.

videos.title: Phas Gaya Bechara Sajan
videos.overview: Chedilal is unhappy about Sanjana's decision to marry Love Guru Aashiq Awara. Meanwhile, is Kashmira having an affair with Aashiq Awara?

videos.title: Sajan Hua Badnaam
videos.overview: To make her company famous, Sanjana makes Sajan a part of her controversy and tells the media that he had tried to harass her. Later, Kashmira drives Sajan out of the house! Where will Sajan go?

videos.title: Chedi Complains Against Sajan
videos.overview: Sajan wears a sari to stop people from recognising him. Later, he manages to convince Kashmira about the controversy. Meanwhile, Chedilal is adamant on filing a FIR against Sajan.

videos.title: Madam Ki Tarkeeb Kaam Ayegi?
videos.overview: Sajan’s mother-in-law presents his case in court, while Chedilal defends Sanjana. The two try to prove their respective clients to be innocent. Later, Sanjana comes up with a plan and shares it with Sajan. What is it?

videos.title: Hum Tum Ek Gufe Mein Phase Ho
videos.overview: Sanjana and Sajan get stranded and find shelter in a cave when their car breaks down. Sajan falls unconscious due to extreme cold and finds himself in a sticky situation. The next day, Sanjana plays a prank on him.

videos.title: Sanjana Is Pregnant!
videos.overview: While Sanjana tells Sajan that she is pregnant with his child, at home, Kashmira, too desires to have a child. Ab kya karega Sajan?

videos.title: Kashmira Seduces Sajan
videos.overview: Sanjana tells Sajan that she will do a DNA test to prove that he is the father. Meanwhile, Kashmira tries to seduce Sajan!

videos.title: Madam Ne Bataya Kashmira Ko
videos.overview: Khiloni advises Sajan to use poison when he decides to commit suicide. At Chedi's birthday party, Sanjana tells Kashmira that she is pregnant with Sajan's child!

videos.title: Sajan Turns Into A Matchmaker
videos.overview: Kashmira gets angry when Sajan suggests Chedi's marriage with his mother-in-law. The following day, Sanjana arranges for a date for her dad. Will Sajan be able to persuade his mother-in-law to go on a date?

videos.title: Sajan Sedates His Mother-in-law
videos.overview: Kashmira finds her mother with Chedilal at the restaurant. Later, Sajan tries to manipulate his mother-in-law to elope with Chedilal. After Kashmira falls asleep, he manages to sedate his mother-in-law and take her to Chedilal.

videos.title: Sajan Bana Babysitter!
videos.overview: Sajan brings his mother-in-law to Sanjana's house where they set up the marriage altar. The following day, Sanjana asks Sajan to look after her friend's baby. Can Sajan do it?

videos.title: Sajan Ka Bachcha Kahan Hai?
videos.overview: Kashmira throws Sajan out of the house on seeing him with a baby. Later, Sajan stops Sanjana from finding out that the baby is missing!

videos.title: Sajan Ke Peeche Chedi!
videos.overview: Sajan's mother-in-law meets Chedilal and learns about his plan to expose Sajan. Sajan tries to hide something from Sanjana. Will he be caught?

videos.title: Bhupesh, Madam Saath Saath

videos.title: A Shocker For Sajan
